description: This Java class provides utility methods for working with CompletableFuture objects, specifically to collect results from multiple futures into a list within a single future.

classes.name: CompletableFutureUtils
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for aggregating and manipulating CompletableFutures.

methods.name: collectAsList
methods.description: Aggregates a list of CompletableFutures into a single CompletableFuture containing a list of their results.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Internal method that combines multiple CompletableFutures into one, applying a collector to gather their results.
